newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares end lightly up on whiff of optimism.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares end lightly up on whiff of optimism.

text.p: Lima stocks ended slightly higher on a whiff of investor optimism and bargain-buying of leaders, brokers said.
"Today the bolsa saw a clear, buying trend which contrasts with the apathy throughout November," said Alberto Giha, of 4G brokerage.
Analysts predicted stability or a continuing upward march on Tuesday.
In Monday's session, the General Index rose 0.32 percent to 1,438.18 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index gained 0.16 percent to 2,031.61 points.
Total market volume was 26 million soles ($10 million) on 1,227 trades, as overall 29 stocks rose, 29 were flat and 20 fell.
Brokers said investors were enthused by cheap prices and November's encouraging inflation figure of 0.47 percent.
"You can see a recovery in the market," said Aldo Servini, of Provalor brokerage.

Among leaders, benchmark Telefonica del Peru gained 0.20 percent to 5.08 soles on 1.35 million shares, while brewery Compania Nacional de Cerveza rose 1.54 percent to 1.32 soles on 139,558 shares, and another brewery Backus y Johnston advanced 0.87 percent to 2.32 soles on 271,765 shares.
